Title: Hyperscale (Citus) backup now supports availability zones

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL—Hyperscale (Citus) now supports Availability Zones for node backup storage and is generally available. Automated backup enabled on each Hyperscale (Citus) node throughout the cluster lifecycle is now replicated to three availability zones in Azure regions that support Availability Zones. Use this capability to perform restore of your Hyperscale (Citus) cluster and get access to your data if at least one availability zone is available in region.

Learn more by reading the service documentation for Hyperscale (Citus).
